note: Health probes for runtime-dep targets in the JTBD graph (row jtbd-graph-s3-gates). One entry per dep id: the file:line that exercises it and a needle that must be on that line. Read by scripts/jtbd_graph_gates.py rule RUNTIME-DEP-NO-PROBE. A probe must be code (not .md/.json/.txt, not a comment line); an env probe's line must name the variable. Line numbers move when the file is edited; the gate then goes red and the entry is re-pointed. DATABASE_URL has no entry: the deep probe only lists it among required env names (route.ts:31), a string list that calls nothing, which the rule does not count as a probe.

dep:env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.kind: key exercised by the deep probe call
